systemic_patterns.title: Known defects keep being re-reported
systemic_patterns.detail: 6 of 12 analyzed defects (50%) matched a high-confidence historical duplicate, so reporting effort is being spent on failures the organisation has already seen.
systemic_patterns.recommendation: Surface the duplicate check at report time and confirm that the matched historical fixes were actually released; a duplicate that keeps recurring usually means the original fix was incomplete.

systemic_patterns.title: IllegalStateException is a recurring failure mode
systemic_patterns.detail: IllegalStateException accounts for 3 of 12 analyzed defects (25%), spanning 1 component(s).
evidence: E2E-01: Login crashes for every user in production
E2E-12: Nightly batch job fails intermittently
systemic_patterns.recommendation: Treat IllegalStateException as a class of defect rather than a series of incidents: add a shared guard or validation utility at the component boundary and a lint or test rule that catches the pattern before release.

systemic_patterns.title: One code location fails repeatedly
systemic_patterns.detail: 3 separate submissions failed at validate in LoginService.java, which indicates an unresolved defect rather than independent incidents.
systemic_patterns.recommendation: Re-open the investigation at validate in LoginService.java. Verify that the previously applied fix addressed the cause rather than the symptom, and add a regression test that reproduces the original failure.
